request: Create a cron job so the Supabase project is less likely to pause from inactivity
title: Scheduled Supabase activity check
purpose: Generate recurring external user database activity for the free Supabase project

files.purpose: Generate recurring external user database activity for the free Supabase project
files.previous_behavior: File did not exist in the baseline commit.
files.new_behavior: GitHub Actions runs SELECT 1 against the project's database three times daily and allows a manual run. A missing secret or failed query fails the job.
files.data_impact: Reads only a constant expression from the production database; no table rows are read or written and no schema changes occur.
files.access_control_impact: The workflow receives a repository-scoped Actions secret containing the database connection URL. No database grants or application permissions change.
risks: A public repository's scheduled workflow may be disabled after 60 days without repository activity.
Scheduled user queries lower pause risk but Supabase does not guarantee free projects will remain active.
Repository writers can change this workflow and thereby use its database credential.
files.rollback: Delete or disable the workflow and remove the SUPABASE_KEEPALIVE_DATABASE_URL repository secret. No data rollback is needed.

production_safety.operational_data: No production table data was read, created, updated, or deleted during implementation. Future runs read a constant through the database connection.
production_safety.schema_migration: None; no migration or backfill was run.
external_side_effects: Created the repository-scoped GitHub Actions secret SUPABASE_KEEPALIVE_DATABASE_URL.

verification.command: python -c "import yaml; from pathlib import Path; yaml.safe_load(Path('.github/workflows/supabase-keepalive.yml').read_text())"
verification.evidence: The workflow parsed successfully and contains the query job.
SUPABASE_KEEPALIVE_DATABASE_URL is present as a repository secret; its value was not printed.
The workflow cannot be dispatched until its file is pushed to the default branch.

residual_risks: The first remote run remains to be checked after the workflow is pushed.
Scheduled GitHub Actions can be delayed or disabled, and free-plan activity is not a no-pause guarantee.
